map.减排优先于抵消，碳汇多用于剩余难减量的中和，不宜替代直接减排。结果按公开标准与环: Reduction takes priority over offset; carbon sinks are mainly for neutralising hard-to-abate residuals and should not replace direct reduction. Results are estimated from public standards and environmental factors, for science communication, teaching and emission-reduction estimation; the actual accounting follows official guidance (e.g. GHG Protocol, provincial emission factors) and measured data.
